name: bixel-native
title_zh: 15 个技能打包卖，挑着装不拆零
tagline_zh: 别家一个技能占一格，这包一次给你 15 个候选。装之前先看清单，勾哪个装哪个，不用的不占地方。
tagline_en: One slot, 15 candidates. Browse the list, tick what you need, skip the rest — no clutter.
why_zh: 它把选择权放在安装前：先看目录再勾选，避免装完才发现不是你要的。适合拿不准具体要哪个。
why_en: Choice before install: browse the manifest, tick only what fits. For when you know you need more skills but aren't sure which.
limit_zh: 只提供 15 个技能的清单和安装入口，不保证每个技能都经过深度打磨；装完若发现某个不好用，得自己回仓库找替代品。
limit_en: Ships a manifest of 15 skills, not deep polish on each. If one disappoints, you'll need to source a replacement yourself.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 15 skills in one pack, install as you need
